objects.description: [WIRTE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0090) has registered domains designed to mimic legitimate sites for use in phishing campaigns.(Citation: Check Point Wirte NOV 2024)(Citation: Palo Alto Ashen Lepus DEC 2025)
